BAR/X is a special BarOS system. It is based on A/UX, most presumably 3.1, and similar to BarOS 8, but with special features:

Both BarOS and Progressbar game modes
Mailbox
Terminus
Calendar
Barari
PB Jams
Much like beta versions of Progressbar, you can get this system by unlocking BarOS 13 and then obtaining 1500000 points. According to the "about" box, this system was created in 1991, the same year as BarOS 7.
